material_source: Repository owner confirmed material and requested this teaching example
selection: Five records evenly spaced in file order: 1, 126, 251, 376, 501; selected before fitting, not by fit quality
units: Frequencies in MHz; phase, baseline and basesub retain recorded units; no independently supplied voltage conversion
grid: Exact 500-bin teaching grid: f_j = 32.3 + 0.0015287*j MHz, j=0..499
export_policy: Derived 500-bin arrays; float64 linear interpolation of raw phase and recorded baseline, then subtraction
polarization_policy: No experimental polarization value is used as fit input or truth; polarization is inferred from the lineshape
hardware_status: Cable, coil and tuning constants for this acquisition have not been independently supplied; do not inherit the butanol setup as a measured constraint

resampling.method: Piecewise linear interpolation in frequency, applied independently to phase and baseline in float64; basesub = phase - baseline
resampling.endpoint_policy: Clamp only endpoint roundoff within four floating-point spacings; no physical extrapolation
resampling.support_policy: Use the confirmed target window; source frequencies beyond its upper endpoint are outside the working example
resampling.noise_policy: Interpolation changes noise correlation and resolution; no independent-bin noise or measured covariance claim
resampling.model_policy: Evaluate the conditional model on source frequencies and apply the same interpolation before fitting all 500 target bins
